description: This file defines the FaultableConsumerGrain class, an Orleans grain implementation for testing fault injection in stream consumption. It manages stream subscription, fault simulation based on time, and tracks consumption and error counts.

classes.name: FaultableConsumerGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class that acts as a fault-injecting stream consumer for testing purposes, capable of simulating failures based on a configurable time period.

methods.name: FaultableConsumerGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grain with a logger.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon activation, resets internal counters and state.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets internal counters and handles to initial state.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon deactivation, logs deactivation.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specified stream as a consumer.

methods.name: SetFailPeriod
methods.description: Configures the failure period during which the grain will simulate failures.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Unsubscribes the grain from the stream.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the count of successfully consumed events.

methods.name: GetNumberFailed
methods.description: Returns the count of failed events.

methods.name: GetErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the count of errors encountered.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream events, simulating failures based on the configured fail period.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream error notifications, increments error count.
